==Description==
The '''Crab''' is a unit spawned by the [[Sandcastle (Consumable)|Sandcastle]] consumable. It spawns every second from it, reducing the health of the [[Sandcastle (Consumable)|Sandcastle]] by 25. Once the [[Sandcastle (Consumable)|Sandcastle]]'s health runs out, it will no longer spawn. It will walk from the entrance of the [[Sandcastle (Consumable)|Sandcastle]] to the exit, dealing collision damage to any enemy it comes across.

==Appearance==
The '''Crab''' is a red and yellow crab.

==Strategy==
*The '''Crabs''' spawned by the [[Sandcastle (Consumable)|Sandcastle]] can be a decent option for clearing out weaker early game enemies like the [[Abnormal]].
*Since the '''Crabs''' spawned by the [[Sandcastle (Consumable)|Sandcastle]] reduce its health, they can be seen as a way for the [[Sandcastle (Consumable)|Sandcastle]] to reach enemies before they reach it, making it faster at clearing out enemies than the [[Barricade]].
